text_block_list.text:
As soon as they started,
I understood. This is what Gran Alegria 
meant when she said 『I'll show you I can
make that dream real!』

Both of them were off to a great start. 
Gran Alegria didn't seem nervous either.

But, her opponent was Taiki Shuttle.
An opponent with overwhelming 
strength was facing an Uma Musume who hadn't
even debuted——

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: …… Haa, haaaaaaa……!!

I realized it immediately after seeing Gran
Alegria run for real for the first time.
She was still a little rough 
around the edges,
but I could sense an exceptional strength.

Even breathing and a steady speed.
Even against someone like 
Taiki Shuttle she had the mental strength
to remain calm.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
……! Fufu,
I can feel the heat behind me……! 
Gran's gaze is giving me goosebumps!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But……more, more……! 
This isn't enough for me!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That which I couldn't obtain…… 
With that passion,
let me feel more of it……!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Haa…… haa……amazing, she's amazing! 
Every step feels like it's pressuring me
directly……!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
…… Ahaa! I'm getting fired up……it's fun,
it's so fun! 
Miles really are the best! Milers are the best!
I'm, I'm…

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Really getting motivated……!!

She was speeding up,
with no signs of slowing. 
She was trying to line up with that Taiki
Shuttle.

I swallowed. 
I could feel the potential in Gran Alegria's
running.

It wasn't……such a far-fetched dream. 
She had the potential within her to reach
a dream like that.
——Suddenly——

I could see myself standing amidst the
cheering. 
With Gran Alegria standing beside me,
laughing.

I realized it was just my imagination,
but as I continued 
watching her run,
those images wouldn't stop coming to mind.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!!!!

——Conquering all three distances.
The true Mile Queen. 
It wasn't just a dream,
she was overflowing with potential.

She could.
If it was her——
then she might be able to do it.

She could do it. She could reach that dream.
Together with 
Gran Alegria——
we could be the ones that those cheers were
for.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Haaa～! I worked up a nice sweat! 
Today too,
I'll take a nice shower and feel
refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu. Just like I thought,
it was really exciting. 
I'm really looking forward to her running
from now on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ……conquering all three distances.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Show it to me too. 
A scene that I couldn't see,
no matter how much I wanted to.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, Trainer-san, how was that!? 
Doesn't it make you want to form a real
contract!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Taiki-senpai's running was really
awesome! 
As expected of a Miler. Of course, me too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ? Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes?
choice_data_list: I want to chase that dream with you!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Wah! So you're on board now!?

I could see Gran Alegria standing as the
true Mile Queen. 
I could see us basking in the cheers
together.

In my excitement,
I ended up saying everything that came to
mind. 
That's how excited I was,
I couldn't stop myself.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ! Potential……

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King's T...
text_block_list.text:
For an Uma Musume,
distance compatibility is a huge barrier. 
However,
a Miler is overflowing with potential.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King's T...
text_block_list.text:
A potential that can overcome even 
that distance compatibility barrier.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(……the potential within me. 
If I can find that, then I……I can……)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san can see my potential……

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
『Miles are the best!
It's the birth of the True Mile Queen!』

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(——so many people.
A huge cheer erupts through the crowd)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Now……just now! 
I've come up with a new MiRule!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
When I win,
I'll definitely look for Trainer-san! 
And then, I'll get you to say it.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
『If it's Gran Alegria,
then it's only natural!』!! 
This will be my……no,
Trainer-san's and MiRule!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
And then,
when we eventually conquer all three
distances——

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I want you to say 『We made it, together!』

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I want you to say 『We made it, together!』

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san!
Please form a contract with me! 
Let's chase after that dream together!

Was it really okay to decide everything
based on MiRules?——
That was the only thing that had 
me worried,
so I decided to ask her about it.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's just the starting point!
I just thought if someone 
fit MiRules,
they'd be more likely to share the same
dream.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
But now, I've got a new MiRule! 
It has to be with Trainer-san,
otherwise it won't be possible.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
……Trainer-san! 
Let's fulfill our dream!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The True Mile Queen…… 
Conquering the three distances——
we'll show that Miles are the best!

……conquering all three distances,
becoming the True Mile Queen. 
It's a wonderful dream isn't it,
Gran-chan?
——However.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
……The one who will carve out that legend first,
will be me.
